message.content:
Plan is in **`projects/voice-assistant/PLAN.md`**. Here's the shape of it:

**Approach I chose** (asked, no answer came, so I decided): **hybrid intent parser** — rules/patterns for your 50 recorded Gulf commands, LLM fallback for anything else. Rules-only offline mode is the safety net, so a dead API or bad Lab 3 Wi‑Fi can't kill the demo. Needs Dr. Noura's nod.

**Five phases, 17 days to the demo**

| Phase | Window | Gate |
|---|---|---|
| 1 · Freeze pipeline | Oct 29 – Nov 4 | Whisper WER measured, 50 commands frozen in `commands.csv`, STT baseline tagged |
| 2 · Intent parser | Nov 5 – 9 | ≥90% intent accuracy on the 50 clips |
| 3 · Actions + TTS + integration | Nov 10 – 12 | live end-to-end, mic→reply under ~3s, 4–6 skills max |
| 4 · Harden & rehearse | Nov 13 – 15 | offline mode, demo script rehearsed 3×, **video backup recorded** |
| 5 · Report | Nov 16 – Dec 10 | draft Dec 5, submit Dec 10 |

Two collisions I planned around: the **IS midterm on Nov 5** (2h/day cap before it, light days Nov 5–6) and the **AI final on Nov 20** (Saut pauses right after the demo).

Also updated the project README to link the plan, and logged the decision in MEMORY.MD.

**Do these today:** message Dr. Noura for the meeting, then freeze the command list. Want me to draft the message to her, or scaffold `commands.csv` and `intents.yaml`?
